folds.title: What a hook is
points: A **hook** is a shell command Claude Code runs automatically at a set moment, like after a file edit.
So certain actions always happen, instead of relying on Claude to remember.

folds.title: Hooks attach to events
points: **Before a tool runs**: can block it.

folds.title: Handy hooks
points: **When Claude is waiting for you:** get a desktop notification.
**Before an edit:** stop changes to protected files.
folds.note: Each one happens every time, with no reminders needed.

folds.title: Adding hooks
points: You add hooks in a settings file.
Type `/hooks` in a session to browse the ones you have.
Hooks run commands on your machine, so only add ones you understand.

folds.title: Hook or CLAUDE.md?
points: **CLAUDE.md** is guidance Claude may or may not follow.
A **hook** is enforced by the program itself.
Use a hook for rules that cannot have exceptions.

folds.prompt: CLAUDE.md or hook? Tap the basket.
